# CLI reference

Every command and every flag, from each command's own flag set.
Go's `flag` accepts one dash or two, so `-image` and `--image` are the same flag.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`kelyfos doctor`](#kelyfos-doctor) | check this machine can run KelyfOS |
| [`kelyfos run`](#kelyfos-run) | boot a sandbox and keep it running |
| [`kelyfos exec`](#kelyfos-exec) | run a command inside a running sandbox |
| [`kelyfos mcp`](#kelyfos-mcp) | bridge an MCP client's stdio to a sandbox |
| [`kelyfos serve-mcp`](#kelyfos-serve-mcp) | serve KelyfOS itself as an MCP server |
| [`kelyfos snapshot save`](#kelyfos-snapshot-save) | save a sandbox's state, or bring it back |
| [`kelyfos snapshot restore`](#kelyfos-snapshot-restore) | save a sandbox's state, or bring it back |
| [`kelyfos pause`](#kelyfos-pause) | freeze a running sandbox under a name |
| [`kelyfos resume`](#kelyfos-resume) | bring a paused session back |
| [`kelyfos sessions`](#kelyfos-sessions) | list paused sessions, or discard one |
| [`kelyfos fork`](#kelyfos-fork) | restore one snapshot into several sandboxes |
| [`kelyfos team up`](#kelyfos-team-up) | run several agents with the paths between them written down and enforced |
| [`kelyfos team ps`](#kelyfos-team-ps) | run several agents with the paths between them written down and enforced |
| [`kelyfos team down`](#kelyfos-team-down) | run several agents with the paths between them written down and enforced |
| [`kelyfos shim`](#kelyfos-shim) | serve an E2B-compatible REST subset |
| [`kelyfos log`](#kelyfos-log) | replay, follow or verify a session's record |
| [`kelyfos watch`](#kelyfos-watch) | live view of a sandbox (reads the record only) |
| [`kelyfos bench`](#kelyfos-bench) | measure cold boot-to-ready over several runs |
| [`kelyfos version`](#kelyfos-version) | print the version and exit |
| [`kelyfos help`](#kelyfos-help) | print this list |

## kelyfos doctor

Check this machine can run KelyfOS.

```
kelyfos doctor
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--arch` | string | the build host's architecture | architecture to check images for |

## kelyfos run

Boot a sandbox and keep it running.

```
kelyfos run [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--allow` | string | — | comma-separated egress allowlist, e.g. github.com,pypi.org. Without it the sandbox has no network interface at all. |
| `--arch` | string | the build host's architecture | guest architecture (aarch64\|x86_64) |
| `--console` | boolean | — | stream the guest serial console |
| `--cpu-quota` | string | uncapped | host CPU time cap as a share of one core, e.g. 150% |
| `--cpus` | int | 2 | virtual CPUs the guest sees |
| `--disk` | string | no ceiling | ceiling on the packed workspace image, e.g. 2G |
| `--idle-timeout` | string | no limit | stop the sandbox after this long with no activity, e.g. 5m |
| `--image` | string | "base" | image flavor |
| `--image-dir` | string | the build output | directory holding the kernel and rootfs |
| `--max-runtime` | string | no limit | stop the sandbox after this long, e.g. 30m |
| `--mem` | string | 512 | guest memory, e.g. 2G or 512M; a bare number is MiB |
| `--no-sync-back` | boolean | — | do not write the workspace back to the host on shutdown |
| `--ready-timeout` | duration | 30s | how long to wait for the guest to become ready |
| `--secret` | value | — | attach a credential to a domain: NAME@domain[:bearer\|basic]. The value is read from the host environment and never enters the guest. Repeatable. |
| `--vcpus` | int | — | alias for --cpus, kept so v0.3 command lines keep working |
| `--verbose-boot` | boolean | — | drop the quiet parameter from the kernel command line |
| `--workspace` | string | — | host directory to make available at /work inside the sandbox |

## kelyfos exec

Run a command inside a running sandbox.

```
kelyfos exec [flags] <command>
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--cwd` | string | / | working directory inside the guest |
| `--sandbox` | string | the only running one | sandbox id |
| `--shell` | boolean | true | run a single argument through /bin/sh -c |
| `--stdin` | boolean | — | forward this process's stdin to the command |
| `--timeout` | duration | — | kill the command after this long (0 = no limit) |

## kelyfos mcp

Bridge an MCP client's stdio to a sandbox.

```
kelyfos mcp [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--sandbox` | string | the only running one | sandbox id |
| `--timeout` | duration | 15s | how long to wait for the sandbox channel |

## kelyfos serve-mcp

Serve KelyfOS itself as an MCP server.

```
kelyfos serve-mcp [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--arch` | string | the build host's architecture | guest architecture (aarch64\|x86_64) |
| `--policy` | string | search upward from the working directory | path to the project's kelyfos.toml |

## kelyfos snapshot save

Save a sandbox's state, or bring it back.

```
kelyfos snapshot save
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--name` | string | "default" | snapshot name |
| `--sandbox` | string | the only running one | sandbox id |

## kelyfos snapshot restore

Save a sandbox's state, or bring it back.

```
kelyfos snapshot restore
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--allow` | string | whatever the snapshot recorded | egress allowlist for the restored machine |
| `--arch` | string | the build host's architecture | guest architecture |
| `--console` | boolean | — | stream the guest serial console |
| `--image` | string | "dev" | image flavor the snapshot was taken from |
| `--name` | string | "default" | snapshot name |
| `--secret` | value | — | attach a credential to a domain: NAME@domain[:bearer\|basic]. Repeatable. |

## kelyfos pause

Freeze a running sandbox under a name.

```
kelyfos pause --as <name>
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--as` | string | — | name to store the paused session under |
| `--sandbox` | string | the only running one | sandbox id |

## kelyfos resume

Bring a paused session back.

```
kelyfos resume <name>
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--console` | boolean | — | stream the guest serial console |
| `--no-sync-back` | boolean | — | leave the workspace image alone at the end |

## kelyfos sessions

List paused sessions, or discard one.

```
kelyfos sessions [rm <name>]
```

No flags.

## kelyfos fork

Restore one snapshot into several sandboxes.

```
kelyfos fork [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--arch` | string | the build host's architecture | guest architecture |
| `--image` | string | "dev" | image flavor the snapshot was taken from |
| `--n` | int | 2 | how many forks to create |
| `--name` | string | "default" | snapshot to fork from |

## kelyfos team up

Run several agents with the paths between them written down and enforced.

```
kelyfos team up
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--arch` | string | the build host's architecture | guest architecture (aarch64\|x86_64) |
| `--ready-timeout` | duration | 1m0s | how long to wait for each guest |

## kelyfos team ps

Run several agents with the paths between them written down and enforced.

```
kelyfos team ps
```

No flags.

## kelyfos team down

Run several agents with the paths between them written down and enforced.

```
kelyfos team down
```

No flags.

## kelyfos shim

Serve an E2B-compatible REST subset.

```
kelyfos shim [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--addr` | string | "127.0.0.1:3000" | address to serve on |
| `--allow` | string | — | egress allowlist for sandboxes the shim creates |
| `--arch` | string | the build host's architecture | guest architecture |
| `--image` | string | "dev" | image flavor for sandboxes the shim creates |

## kelyfos log

Replay, follow or verify a session's record.

```
kelyfos log [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--export` | string | — | write a self-contained HTML report to this path |
| `--follow` | boolean | — | stream events as they are recorded |
| `--json` | boolean | — | print the raw events instead of a readable replay |
| `--list` | boolean | — | list recorded sessions |
| `--session` | string | the most recent | session id |
| `--verify` | boolean | — | check the hash chain and report the first break |

## kelyfos watch

Live view of a sandbox (reads the record only).

```
kelyfos watch [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--session` | string | the most recent | session id |

## kelyfos bench

Measure cold boot-to-ready over several runs.

```
kelyfos bench [flags]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--arch` | string | the build host's architecture | guest architecture (aarch64\|x86_64) |
| `--image` | string | "base" | image flavor |
| `--image-dir` | string | — | directory holding the kernel and rootfs |
| `--json` | boolean | — | emit the result as JSON |
| `--mem` | int | 512 | guest memory, MiB |
| `--ready-timeout` | duration | 30s | per-boot readiness timeout |
| `--restore` | string | — | measure restores from this snapshot instead of cold boots |
| `--runs` | int | 10 | number of cold boots to measure |
| `--vcpus` | int | 2 | virtual CPUs |

## kelyfos version

Print the version and exit.

```
kelyfos version
```

No flags.

## kelyfos help

Print this list.

```
kelyfos help
```

No flags.
